scenarios.failure: Forged or tampered JWT token payload / signature
scenarios.actual: Token rejected; AuthenticationError raised; no execution allowed

scenarios.failure: Attempted overwrite of existing canonical UCE record (duplicate ID)
scenarios.actual: UNIQUE constraint violation caught; PersistenceError raised

scenarios.expected: PathTraversalError raised; access outside storage root blocked
scenarios.actual: PathTraversalError raised; disk access strictly confined to root

scenarios.failure: Failure during multi-entity semantic batch write
scenarios.expected: Zero partial records written; clean rollback to pre-transaction state
scenarios.actual: Transaction context manager caught exception and issued ROLLBACK

scenarios.failure: Worker thread crash prior to post-persistence offset commit
scenarios.expected: New or surviving consumer resumes from last committed offset; zero event loss
scenarios.actual: Uncommitted events replayed from committed offset table

scenarios.expected: Canonical UCE/semantic store intact; search rebuilt completely via rebuild_index()
scenarios.actual: All indexed events restored from durable semantic repository
